top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts sacrifice identity and reading space before adapting the secondary pane.
top_issues.evidence: At 760 px, rail plus list occupies x0-296 (39% of the window). Calls names start at x128 with call controls already at x219 and x257; Katherine, Ada, Grace and Dorothy truncate.
top_issues.fix: For widths below 800 pt, allow a collapsible 200 pt secondary pane; use one 28 pt call menu per row, preserving at least 140 pt for the name. Keep full identity in a visible selected header.

top_issues.issue: Hover toolbars present too many equally weighted, tightly packed commands.
top_issues.evidence: Group-chat strip spans approximately x964-1252 and y402-441 with ten commands; roughly 28 px per item, combining six emoji with reply, edit, delete and copy. Narrow chat still presents seven commands in about 204 px.
top_issues.fix: Keep three reactions, Reply and a More menu; use 32 x 32 pt targets, 4 pt group gaps and a 1 pt separator before message-management commands. Put Delete inside More.

top_issues.issue: Small supporting text carries consequential instructions and state.
top_issues.evidence: Composer footer occupies roughly y774-783 (10 px ink height); settings explanatory paragraph is three lines at y432-471; attachment size occupies about y691-698. Palette passes: #62656D on #FFFFFF 5.83:1 and #9C9EA8 on #25262B 5.66:1. Small size, rather than failed color contrast, limits readability.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt for actionable help and errors, 12 pt minimum for timestamps and attachment size, with 17-18 pt line height. Reserve 11 pt for optional section captions only.

top_issues.issue: Explanatory prose crowds the task and weakens progressive disclosure.
top_issues.evidence: Settings background-refresh explanation spans y432-471; at y710 the dock-call option meets the bottom fade. Setup uses y280-325 for a paragraph, y470-495 for tenant advice, and y589-620 for two more notes. Calls-narrow explanation occupies four lines at y229-290.
top_issues.fix: Keep one 13 pt explanatory sentence per group and move registration/environment details into a labelled disclosure. Use 20 pt between groups and 8 pt between label, field and helper. Reduce the initial calls explanation to two lines.

top_issues.issue: Active-call controls do not clearly explain the consequence of closing the bar.
top_issues.evidence: At x239-337,y58-86 the control is labelled Close bar beside Restore. The screenshot says In the meeting, but exposes no explicit distinction between hiding this interface and leaving the call.
top_issues.fix: Label the action Hide call bar and place 12 pt helper text saying Meeting continues in Teams. Rename Restore to Restore Wren window; allow wrapping into two rows at 380 pt width.

top_issues.issue: Highlighting an unpicked search result competes with the actual recipient selection.
top_issues.evidence: Grace Hopper is a chip at x400-543,y157-189; Barbara Liskov simultaneously has a full-width gray highlight at x400-880,y269-313. Primary action still says Chat with Grace Hopper.
top_issues.fix: Add a checked marker and Selected label to recipient chips; use a 2 pt focus outline for the active search result and retain fill plus check only for added recipients. Add 12 pt Enter to add helper below results.

top_issues.issue: The long draft clips a partial text line against the upper edge, and its scroll affordance crowds the action area.
top_issues.evidence: Focused composer spans x380-1264,y553-761; fragments of a preceding line remain around y561. Small thumb sits around x1178-1184,y738-753 beside the bottom action row.
top_issues.fix: Give the text viewport 12 pt top padding and a 16 pt bottom inset; keep a separate 32 pt action row outside the scroll area. Use an 8 pt scroll thumb and 8 pt separation from actions.

top_issues.issue: Selection fills are very subtle; the accent stripe is doing most of the work.
top_issues.evidence: Measured selected chat fill #E4E4E8 versus list #F6F6F7 is 1.17:1; dark #34353C versus #1D1E22 is about 1.35:1. The orange stripe is visible, so this is a robustness concern, not a claimed WCAG selection failure.
top_issues.fix: Keep the 3 pt accent stripe and add a selected check or consistent bold title. Increase fill separation to light #DDDDE3 and dark #3D3E47, retaining secondary text at #4A4D55 / #C2C4CC for comfortable contrast.

top_issues.issue: Input and checkbox outlines have almost no contrast margin.
top_issues.evidence: Real border pixels: #8A8D95 on #F6F6F7 3.07:1; #6E7179 on #25262B 3.09:1. These pass the 3:1 threshold, but look thin, especially the 16 px unchecked settings checkbox.
top_issues.fix: Use light border #7A7D85 and dark border #858892 with a 1 pt stroke; use 18 pt checkbox boxes within at least 28 pt rows. Preserve the existing 2 pt orange focus outline.

top_issues.issue: Attachment identity is weak when aspect ratios differ dramatically.
top_issues.evidence: Composer previews are about 144 x 96 px for dimensions 3072 x 256, 256 x 256 and 256 x 3072. The first and third are strongly cropped. Preview header shows only 3072 x 256 beside Fit/100%.
top_issues.fix: Show a 12 pt filename above dimensions; use contain-fit previews within 144 x 96 pt tiles and retain a 24 pt remove target. Include the filename in the image-preview header.

top_issues.issue: Meeting actions are spatially detached from their supporting details.
top_issues.evidence: Main card occupies approximately x388-1028,y98-309, but Join is at x1199-1264,y12-40. Nearly the whole lower pane is blank.
top_issues.fix: Place a 32 pt high Join button and Copy link at the bottom of the detail card with 16 pt top spacing, or align the header action group to the same 640 pt content column. Raise meeting title to 18 pt.

top_issues.issue: Time-dependent states lack visible duration guidance.
top_issues.evidence: Device code card at y302-572 shows code, waiting text and three buttons without a validity line. Status message dialog at y120-337 shows only text entry, Cancel and Save without a clearing policy. Browser waiting card similarly has no visible validity guidance.
top_issues.fix: Add one 12-13 pt validity/expiry line below the device code and browser waiting status; show the actual status-clearing policy beneath the status input, with 8 pt separation. Do not invent a duration; display the underlying service value.
